from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric extracted from a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    line_item_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item (e.g., '公允价值变动收益')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for this line item")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this value corresponds to")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., '元', '万元')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text from the document anchoring this data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_line_items: list[FinancialLineItem]
